name: AgentProof
description: Concept / early access, not a live service. Would let an AI agent show a merchant that a person authorized an agent-initiated purchase, and produce a dispute evidence packet for Shopify or Stripe. This card is static. The url does not accept A2A JSON-RPC, and no proof is issued.

skills.name: Authorization proof
skills.description: Hypothetical skill. Would accept a record that a person confirmed an agent-initiated purchase and return a reference a merchant could later put in a Shopify or Stripe dispute packet. Not executable on this host.
examples: Record that the person confirmed an illustrative 42.00 USD purchase at a Shopify store before the agent paid. This example is not a real order.
